name: Stickelberger.galEquiv_apply_comm
statement:
theorem galEquiv_apply_comm {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {L : Type*} [Field L] [NumberField L]
    [IsCyclotomicExtension {n} ℚ L] (σ τ : L ≃ₐ[ℚ] L) (x : L) : τ (σ x) = σ (τ x)

name: Stickelberger.galMul_eq_canonical
statement:
theorem galMul_eq_canonical :
    (IsIntegralClosure.MulSemiringAction ℤ ℚ K (𝓞 K) : MulSemiringAction (K ≃ₐ[ℚ] K) (𝓞 K))
      = (inferInstance : MulSemiringAction (K ≃ₐ[ℚ] K) (𝓞 K))

name: Stickelberger.msa_eq_of_distrib
statement:
theorem msa_eq_of_distrib {M R : Type*} [Monoid M] [Semiring R] (a b : MulSemiringAction M R)
    (hd : a.toDistribMulAction = b.toDistribMulAction) : a = b

name: Stickelberger.div_mul_mod_eq
statement:
theorem div_mul_mod_eq {ℓ m k : ℕ} (hm0 : 0 < m) (hmdvd : m ∣ ℓ - 1) :
    (ℓ - 1) / m * k % (ℓ - 1) = (ℓ - 1) / m * (k % m)

name: Stickelberger.div_mul_mod_of_mod_eq_one
statement:
theorem div_mul_mod_of_mod_eq_one {r ℓ a k : ℕ} (hr0 : 0 < r) (hrdvd : r ∣ ℓ - 1) (hℓ : 0 < ℓ - 1)
    (ha : a < r) (hk : k % r = 1) :
    ((ℓ - 1) / r * a * k) % (ℓ - 1) = (ℓ - 1) / r * a

name: Stickelberger.div_mul_one_add_mul_mod
statement:
theorem div_mul_one_add_mul_mod {r ℓ a j : ℕ} (hr0 : 0 < r) (hrdvd : r ∣ ℓ - 1)
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ - 1) (ha : a < r) :
    ((ℓ - 1) / r * a * (1 + r * j)) % (ℓ - 1) = (ℓ - 1) / r * a

name: Stickelberger.modEq_sum
statement:
theorem modEq_sum {α : Type*} {n : ℕ} {F G : α → ℕ} {s : Finset α}
    (h : ∀ a ∈ s, F a ≡ G a [MOD n]) : ∑ a ∈ s, F a ≡ ∑ a ∈ s, G a [MOD n]

name: Stickelberger.mod_mul'
statement:
theorem mod_mul' (a : ℕ) {b c : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c) :
    a % (b * c) = a % b + b * (a / b % c)

name: Stickelberger.mul_units_val_eq_floor
statement:
theorem mul_units_val_eq_floor {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] (a : (ZMod m)ˣ) (c : ℕ) :
    c * (a : ZMod m).val = ((a : ZMod m) * (c : ZMod m)).val + m * (c * (a : ZMod m).val / m)

name: Stickelberger.sum_range_div_mod
statement:
theorem sum_range_div_mod (p a m : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    ∑ h ∈ range (a * m), (h / a % p) = a * ∑ k ∈ range m, (k % p)

name: Stickelberger.sum_range_mod
statement:
theorem sum_range_mod (p c : ℕ) :
    ∑ k ∈ range (p * c), (k % p) = c * ∑ d ∈ range p, d

name: Stickelberger.sum_range_rotate
statement:
theorem sum_range_rotate {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (g : ℕ → M) (f k : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ range f, g ((k + i) % f) = ∑ i ∈ range f, g i

name: Stickelberger.s_le
statement:
theorem s_le (hs0 : s 0 = 0) (hs1 : s 1 = 1) (hadd : ∀ a b, s (a + b) ≤ s a + s b) :
    ∀ n, s n ≤ n
  | 0 => by rw [hs0]
  | n + 1 => by
    have h

name: Stickelberger.s_sum_le
statement:
theorem s_sum_le (hs0 : s 0 = 0) (hadd : ∀ a b, s (a + b) ≤ s a + s b) {ι : Type*}
    (g : ι → ℕ) (t : Finset ι) : s (∑ i ∈ t, g i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ t, s (g i)

name: Stickelberger.zetaInteger_isPrimitiveRoot
statement:
theorem zetaInteger_isPrimitiveRoot (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] [IsCyclotomicExtension {n} ℚ K] :
    IsPrimitiveRoot (zetaInteger (K := K) n) n

name: Stickelberger.emultiplicity_map_ringEquiv
statement:
theorem emultiplicity_map_ringEquiv {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (τ : R ≃+* R) (P I : Ideal R) :
    emultiplicity (P.map (τ : R →+* R)) (I.map (τ : R →+* R)) = emultiplicity P I

name: Stickelberger.emultiplicity_smul
statement:
theorem emultiplicity_smul {M R : Type*} [Group M] [CommRing R] [MulSemiringAction M R]
    (σ : M) (P : Ideal R) (x : R) :
    emultiplicity (σ • P) (Ideal.span {σ • x}) = emultiplicity P (Ideal.span {x})

name: Stickelberger.liesOver_of_natCast_mem
statement:
theorem liesOver_of_natCast_mem {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K] {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]
    {Q : Ideal (𝓞 K)} [Q.IsPrime] (hp_mem : (p : 𝓞 K) ∈ Q) :
    Q.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)})
